title: fix: harden detached exec and container shutdown
body:
## Problems

- Detached exec can panic when SysProcAttr is nil, and its watcher can inspect cmd.Process before cmd.Start completes.
- Container shutdown polls /proc once per second, can race with PID reuse, and returns immediately after SIGKILL without confirming exit.

## Fixes

- Initialize SysProcAttr and start the detached process before its watcher.
- Track the container process with pidfd, wait without polling sleeps, and allow a bounded five-second wait after SIGKILL.
- Add regression tests using real child processes for detached exec, pidfd timeout, escalation, and confirmed exit.

## Tests

- go test -mod=vendor ./...
- go test -mod=vendor -race ./pkg/containerutils ./pkg/procutils
- go vet -mod=vendor ./...
- make pty lilipod

title: Fix container init PID detection
body:
GetPid can return a child process because every process in the container sees the same .containerenv. This makes stop kill the wrong process.

Prefer the process whose NSpid ends in 1. Keep the lowest numeric PID as the pid=host fallback.

Tested with:
- go test -mod=vendor ./pkg/containerutils ./cmd
- go vet -mod=vendor ./pkg/containerutils ./cmd

title: Fix read-only bind mounts
body:
Volume mounts with the ro option are currently writable.

This change passes the read-only flag to the mount helper and remounts the bind mount as read-only. It also replaces a symlink at the target path before creating the mount target.

Tested with:
- go test -mod=vendor ./...
- go vet -mod=vendor ./...
- make pty lilipod

title: Fix rootful exec, environment merging, and log file handling
body:
Fixes:

- rootful exec no longer enters a user namespace
- explicit environment values override image defaults
- logs opens current-logs once

Tested with:

- `go test -mod=vendor ./cmd ./pkg/... ./ptyagent`
- `go vet -mod=vendor ./cmd ./pkg/... ./ptyagent`

title: Inconsistent Performance Numbers in the README
body: I am not sure how to reconcile the times quoted in the README.md in the code blocks with the immediately following sentence that it takes "about 5~8ms to enter a container and execute stuff" (see screenshot below). The fastest time in the code blocks is 0.450s for 20 iterations which would be 22.5 ms per iteration, not 5~8ms (even then that is system time, not real time). Is one of these numbers out dated or is there something wrong in one of these calculations?

title: Lilipod fails on the busybox image
body:
Lilipod fails to run the standard docker busybox image:

```
$ lilipod run --rm -ti busybox
rootfs_utils.go:644 [error] error: open /home/adamsmd/.local/share/lilipod/containers/2eec8a3d491a55efa3018d94261b03cc/rootfs/run/.containerenv: no such file or directory
2026/08/16 23:51:38 setup rootfs: open /home/adamsmd/.local/share/lilipod/containers/2eec8a3d491a55efa3018d94261b03cc/rootfs/run/.containerenv: no such file or directory
2026/08/16 23:51:38 exit status 1
2026/08/16 23:51:38 exit status 1
2026/08/16 23:51:38 exit status 1
```

### Diagnosis

Lilipod assumes some things about the container's filesystem (e.g., that `/run` exists) that are not true of the busybox image.

title: rootfs: preserve capabilities for privileged containers
body:
`--privileged` was parsed and stored, but `RunContainer` still replaced the process capability sets with `keepCaps`.

Keep the current behavior for regular containers. Leave inherited capabilities unchanged for privileged containers.

Testing:
- `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./pkg/... ./cmd/... ./ptyagent`
- `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./pkg/... ./cmd/... ./ptyagent`

title: OCI Image export/import support
body:
like `docker save/load`, that makes airgap container deploy possible.

some e.g., `docker save img:tag | ssh anotherhost 'docker load'`

body:
Does lilipod make sense for multi-kernel linux?

title: Implement a build command
body:
This is probably possible using [buildkit](https://github.com/moby/buildkit) if you're open to adding a dependency or run buildkit inside a container in daemonless mode as described [here](https://hub.docker.com/r/moby/buildkit) with a command similar to this:

```
docker run \
    -it \
    --rm \
    --privileged \
    -v /path/to/dir:/tmp/work \
    --entrypoint buildctl-daemonless.sh \
    moby/buildkit:master \
        build \
        --frontend dockerfile.v0 \
        --local context=/tmp/work \
        --local dockerfile=/tmp/work
```
